text: Gomɗii Men yeɗii yimɓe Huudi ɓen e nooneeji newaare, ko Men yeɗaali on. Men waɗani ɓe nanɗe, e giiɗe e ɓerɗe. Kono nanɗe maɓɓe, e giiɗe maɓɓe e ɓerɗe maɓɓe fow duncanaano ɓe goɗɗum, daɗndaali ɓe lepte Allah, tawde ɓe wonuno e yeddugol Allah ɗen, O jippini e maɓɓe, ɗen lepte ɗe ɓe jalkitiraynoo Nulaaɗo maɓɓe on Huudu, si on jertiniriino ɓe ɗe.
